name: ENT OT Report
query: SELECT O.transaction_date AS `Date:Date:100`,O.patient AS `Patient ID:Link/Patient:130`,O.patient_name AS `Patient Name:Data:200`,O.consultant AS `Consultant:Link/Healthcare Practitioner:180`,O.service_name AS `Service Name:Data:300`,CASE WHEN IFNULL(V.has_return,0)=1 THEN 'Return' WHEN IFNULL(V.has_submitted,0)=1 THEN 'Completed' ELSE 'Pending' END AS `Status:Data:100`,IFNULL(CASE WHEN V.has_submitted=1 THEN V.submitted_total ELSE V.draft_total END,O.order_rate) AS `Rate:Currency:120`,IFNULL(CASE WHEN V.has_submitted=1 THEN V.submitted_net_total ELSE 0 END,0) AS `Net Amount:Currency:120`,1 AS `Qty:Int:70`,O.sales_order AS `Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:150`,V.sales_invoice AS `Sales Invoice:HTML:220`,O.comment AS `Comment:Data:300`,O.customer_group AS `Customer Group:Link/Customer Group:150`,P.mobile_no AS `Mobile:Data:120` FROM (SELECT S.name sales_order,S.transaction_date,S.patient,S.patient_name,S.customer_group,S.ref_practitioner consultant,S.comment,GROUP_CONCAT(I.item_code ORDER BY I.idx SEPARATOR ', ') service_name,ROUND(SUM(I.amount),2) order_rate FROM `tabSales Order` S JOIN `tabSales Order Item` I ON I.parent=S.name WHERE S.docstatus=1 AND S.medical_department='ENT' AND I.item_group='OT' AND S.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s GROUP BY S.name,S.transaction_date,S.patient,S.patient_name,S.customer_group,S.ref_practitioner,S.comment) O LEFT JOIN `tabPatient` P ON P.name=O.patient LEFT JOIN (SELECT D.sales_order,MAX(CASE WHEN D.docstatus=1 AND D.is_return=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_return,MAX(CASE WHEN D.docstatus=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) has_submitted,GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('',D.invoice,'') ORDER BY D.invoice SEPARATOR ', ') sales_invoice,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN D.docstatus=1 THEN D.invoice_total ELSE 0 END),2) submitted_total,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN D.docstatus=1 THEN D.net_total ELSE 0 END),2) submitted_net_total,ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN D.docstatus=0 THEN D.invoice_total ELSE 0 END),2) draft_total FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SII.sales_order,SI.name invoice,SI.docstatus,SI.is_return,SI.total invoice_total,SI.net_total FROM `tabSales Order` FS JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` SII ON SII.sales_order=FS.name AND SII.item_group='OT' JOIN `tabSales Invoice` SI ON SI.name=SII.parent WHERE FS.docstatus=1 AND FS.medical_department='ENT' AND FS.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s AND SI.docstatus<2) D GROUP BY D.sales_order) V ON V.sales_order=O.sales_order ORDER BY O.transaction_date,O.sales_order
